requirements.requirement: A system account named inventorysvc exists on node1.
requirements.summary: The account was created with useradd --system, and final post-restart validation observed UID 993 within node1's configured system UID range of 201–999.

requirements.requirement: inventorysvc uses /var/lib/inventory as its home directory.
requirements.summary: Pre- and post-restart checks directly validated the passwd home field and the existing directory at /var/lib/inventory, owned by inventorysvc.

requirements.requirement: inventorysvc has no interactive login access.
requirements.summary: The account uses /usr/sbin/nologin, has a locked password, and an attempted su login was rejected both before and after restart.

overall_summary: All public task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete for node1: it captures a healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement and bounded loss of connectivity, a changed boot identity corroborated by lifecycle snapshots, and recovery of the account, home directory, system state, and services.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Account creation was required (cmd-ad0f6630c4244f72); the transient reboot scheduling supported the mandatory restart protocol (cmd-96149ed9024f4e97); and temporary login-check files were removed within their verification commands (cmd-e8f2b4b453054c1e, cmd-08d553465eae4b03). Final observations show no failed services, healthy package state, no new socket exposure, and only normal reboot-regenerated systemd temporary directories.
